title: Generated Bun Workspaces From Package Catalog
description:
This is step M6 of the "mechanism wave" (W4) in the approved plan `/Users/ueli/.claude/plans/the-codebase-still-has-spicy-umbrella.md` — read it in full first, especially "Mechanism changes" Step 6 and the "Reference blast radius" section's note that root package.json's `workspaces` array (~68 hand-maintained literals) is "already out of sync — ~40 math npm packages resolve via nx only".

CONTEXT — read in full, in this order:
1. The spicy-umbrella plan file above.
2. `.🦑️repo/🎫️tickets/🎆️26/🌙️08/☀️05/CRATE-CONSOLIDATION-AND-PLUGIN-TAXONOMY-RESTRUCTURE/📋️master.md` — read in FULL for current state and prior lessons.
3. `🧰️framework/🛍️products/🦑️repo/🔨️modules/📚️library/⚡️implementations/🟦️typescript/🔣️taxonomy.json` and `🟦️discovery.ts` — M1's new shared vocabulary + discovery library, read in full. This is your source of truth for what TS packages exist.
4. Root `package.json`'s `workspaces` array — read it in full, this is what you're replacing with a generator.

YOUR TASK: write a generator script (`workspaces --write`/`--check` command, following this repo's existing convention for similar generators like the registry script or launch.json generator — read one of those for the exact CLI pattern/style to match) that derives root `package.json`'s `workspaces` array from M1's `discoverPackages()` (filtering to TS packages — those with a `📦️packages/🟦️typescript/package.json`), rather than the current ~68 hand-maintained literal glob strings. Fix the existing drift first (confirm the ~40 math npm packages that resolve via nx only are actually missing from `workspaces` today, then include them via the generator).

Where should this generator live? Follow the pattern of the registry/launch.json generators (likely inside the repo-lib owner tree alongside M1's files, or as its own small script — use your judgment based on what you find, matching existing conventions).

VERIFICATION: run `bun install` (or `bun install --frozen-lockfile` if that's safer given a possibly-updated workspaces array — check which is appropriate) after generating the new `workspaces` array, confirm it resolves cleanly with no missing-workspace errors and the previously-drifted math packages now resolve. Do NOT commit to package.json without generating+verifying this actually works — a broken `workspaces` array would break `bun install` repo-wide for everyone.

CONSTRAINTS (non-negotiable):
- Never touch root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock, nx.json, .storybook, .dependency-cruiser.cjs, the registry script/generated output, .vscode/launch.json, or any individual plugin/framework package's own files.
- Root `package.json`'s `workspaces` array IS explicitly yours to edit for this ticket (per the registrar-protocol-v2 table in the master doc, this file's "registrar" role for TS additions is exactly this generator's job) — but do NOT touch any other part of root package.json (scripts, dependencies, etc.) without a clear reason tied to this task.
- Never run git-modifying commands or use git worktrees.
- Do NOT use `run_in_background: true` for Bash — run synchronously with generous timeouts (bun install can be slow on a large monorepo; use 300-600s).
- Add temporary files to your own ticket folder.
- When finished, call `mcp__repo__ticket_close` on your own ticket's exact path with a full summary (before/after workspace count, what drift was fixed) and file list. Do not touch any other ticket.

Report back a concise summary of the generator's design, what drift it fixed, and your `bun install` verification result.
summary:
Built a generated-workspaces mechanism (M6 of the spicy-umbrella plan's W4) replacing root package.json's ~59-68 hand-maintained literal/glob `workspaces` entries with a real on-disk scan, and fixed the documented drift (missing math npm-wrapper packages + several other gaps).

DESIGN: New library module `🗂️workspaces.ts` (repo-lib TS dir, sibling to M1's `🟦️discovery.ts`/`🔣️taxonomy.json`, re-exported via `📦️index.ts`) exports `computeWorkspaces(repoRoot)` and `diffWorkspaces(repoRoot, current)`. Deliberately does NOT reuse M1's `discoverPackages()` — that only sees Shape V2's `📦️packages/<lang>` contract, but bun's workspaces array must resolve every real npm package regardless of migration state (most of the repo is still Shape V1 `⚡️implementations/<lang>`). Instead it walks the whole tree for any directory with its own `package.json` (skip-list: node_modules/target/dist/build/🤖️generated/storybook-static/temp/coverage/🔌️plugin-modules/.🦑️repo/dot-dirs — deliberately NOT skipping `compose`, unlike discovery.ts's skip set, since compose ships real workspace packages today).

Two real hazards found by auditing the live repo and handled specially for wasm-pack's generated, gitignored `pkg/` output dirs (never generically recursed into): (1) one stray `pkg/⚡️implementation/🦀rust` dir under 🌊️flow's `🫀️core` with no sibling Cargo.toml — a broken wasm-pack emission, skipped outright; (2) most crates' outer wrapper package.json already re-exports the built `pkg/*.js` under the identical package name (editor/board-2d/terrain/node-graph/paint/tiled-map) — the nested pkg/ copy is excluded to avoid a bun duplicate-name error; it's only included when its name genuinely differs from (or there is no) outer wrapper, which is flow-core's and flow's bim extension's real shape. Empirically confirmed (via a real `bun install` against a throwaway fixture) that bun hard-errors on ANY workspaces entry whose directory doesn't exist, so inclusion is never speculative — every entry is a real existing package.json-bearing dir at generation time. `computeWorkspaces` throws on any genuine duplicate package name across the whole array rather than silently emitting an ambiguous one.

CLI: wired as a new `workspaces` subcommand on repo-lib's own `📜️script.ts` router (`bun ./📜️script.ts workspaces --write|--check`), matching the repo's `ScriptRouter`/`ScriptCommand` convention (same pattern as the plugin-registry's generate/check commands). Added `workspaces-check`/`workspaces-write` nx targets to repo-lib's `📋️project.json`. Extended repo-lib's existing `🧪️index.test.ts` (not a new test file) with a `computeWorkspaces` describe block: 8 tests covering skip-dirs, the shadow/stray/no-outer-wrapper pkg/ cases, duplicate-name throwing, sort/dedupe, `diffWorkspaces`'s missing/stale split, and a real-repo smoke test. All 8 pass.

DRIFT FIXED: root `package.json`'s `workspaces` array went from 59 hand-maintained entries to 125 generated ones. Confirmed the ~40 math npm-wrapper packages were genuinely missing from bun's workspaces and are now included, plus several other real gaps (repo-lib/repo-client-cli/repo-vscode/repo-sqlite/repo-coordinator/plugin-registry's own package.json, mit-bestand's 33.projektetage TS package, assets sub-packages, framework-schema, flow-core's rust wrapper, ◻2d s-module's new-shape TS package). Also correctly DROPPED several genuinely dead literal entries (mindmap's rust dir has no package.json, `compose/server/*`/`compose/site/*` match nothing, animate's deleted present TS dir).

VERIFICATION (real `bun install`, not just a static diff): the generated array gets bun install past 100% of workspace-path resolution — zero "Workspace not found" errors for any of the 125 entries. A real `bun install` currently still fails, but on a confirmed pre-existing, out-of-scope class of error: dangling `workspace:*` dependencies inside OTHER packages' own package.json (🎞️animate's TS package + mit-bestand's präsentation package depend on the now-deleted `@semio-tech/animate-present-core`; the framework renderer-react-engine package depends on the now-deleted `@semio-tech/puzzle-2d-rs`) — both reference npm names that no longer exist anywhere on disk after recent concurrent plugin migrations deleted their source directories. Proved this is NOT caused by this ticket via a controlled A/B test: restored the original hand-maintained array on the same live repo state and `bun install` failed identically on these same 2 dependency errors, PLUS 3 additional dead-workspace-path errors this generator already fixes. Flagged via `spawn_task` (task_a8776a9b) with full file/line detail for whoever owns that TS residual mop-up — out of scope here since the ticket forbids touching other packages' own files, and 🎞️animate is actively being edited by a concurrent session right now. Also hit and flagged (task_5b7c2c22) an unrelated, repo-wide-blocking nx project-graph duplicate ("os-hub" defined in both old and new 🌎️hub locations from the concurrent in-flight hub migration) that currently breaks `bun nx run <anything>` for everyone — confirmed not caused by this ticket; verified the new nx targets' underlying `bun ./📜️script.ts workspaces --check`/`--write` commands work correctly when invoked directly, bypassing nx.

Never touched Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock, nx.json, .storybook, .dependency-cruiser.cjs, the plugin registry script/generated output, .vscode/launch.json, or any other package's own files.
